description: This file defines a class EntityIdExistsOption within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the API validation rules. The class manages options related to entity ID validation, such as whether IDs should be numeric and/or positive.

classes.name: EntityIdExistsOption
classes.description: A class that encapsulates options for validating entity IDs, including whether they should be numeric and positive, with getter and setter methods for these options.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Returns whether the ID should be numeric.

methods.name: setNumeric
methods.description: Sets whether the ID should be numeric.

methods.name: isPositive
methods.description: Returns whether the ID should be positive.

methods.name: setPositive
methods.description: Sets whether the ID should be positive.
